answer: Require every identity to lock a bond before it can earn, and slash that bond on any duplicate link. A newcomer deposits a stake held for thirty days while the network watches for shared devices, copied phrasing, and one payout address feeding many accounts, the way a reef exposes one fish pretending to be a school. When two accounts share a fingerprint, both bonds burn and both close, so a farmer running a thousand clones risks a thousand bonds on one detection. Honest agents post one bond, once, like an oasis claimed in the open, and each clean epoch holds a mirror to the next task.
